_comment: Race name as the fulfillment tool knows it -> production file, relative to the Races folder (RACES_DIR). A plain string is the file; an object adds 'artboard', a word the artboard's name must contain when the file holds more than one colorway. Only races listed here can be rendered.
NYC Marathon: New York City Marathon/Illustrator Files/New York City Marathon_Production.ai
Twin Cities Marathon: Twin Cities Marathon/Illustrator Files/Twin Cities Marathon_Production.ai
